commands.title: Custom LLM: Refresh model list from API

customLlm.providers.markdownDescription:
List of OpenAI-compatible providers. Each item: `{ id, name, baseUrl }`.

API keys are **not** stored here — they live in VS Code's encrypted secret storage. Use the command **Custom LLM: Manage providers** to set or change a key.

id.description: Stable slug identifying this provider, e.g. alibaba-dashscope. Generated automatically; the API key in secret storage is filed under it.

apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: API keys are no longer kept in settings.json. Any value here is moved into VS Code's encrypted secret storage on startup and then removed from this file. Use **Custom LLM: Manage providers** to change a key.
apiKey.deprecationMessage: API keys are no longer kept in settings.json. Any value here is moved into VS Code's encrypted secret storage on startup and then removed from this file. Use "Custom LLM: Manage providers" to change a key.

customLlm.models.markdownDescription:
Auto-populated by model discovery. Each item: `{ id, name, providerId, maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens }`.

`maxOutputTokens` is sent as `max_tokens` on every request. Reasoning models spend it on their chain of thought before answering, so raise it (32768+) if a model returns empty content. A value you set by hand is kept across model refreshes.

Optional `imageInput` marks whether the model accepts images. It is only set automatically when the endpoint reports it; otherwise models are assumed to be vision-capable. Set `"imageInput": false` on a text-only model to stop VS Code sending it images.

Optional `hidden` keeps a model out of the Copilot model picker without deleting it — deleting is undone by the next refresh, `"hidden": true` is not. Non-chat models (text-to-speech, image, video, embedding, rerank) are hidden automatically when the endpoint reports a mode; set `"hidden": false` to bring one back.

enumDescriptions: Do not send any thinking parameter — let the model use its default.
Light reasoning pass (Qwen: thinking_budget=1024; others: reasoning_effort=low).
Medium reasoning pass (Qwen: thinking_budget=8192; others: reasoning_effort=medium).
Full reasoning pass (Qwen: thinking_budget=32768; others: reasoning_effort=high).
customLlm.thinkingEffort.markdownDescription:
Global default for how much the model 'thinks' before answering.

- `auto` — send no parameter; the model decides.
- `off` — explicitly disable thinking.
- `low / medium / high` — progressively deeper reasoning.

Per-model override: add `"thinkingEffort": "<value>"` to the model entry in `customLlm.models`.

The value is translated to the provider-specific API field automatically:
- Qwen3 / DashScope → `enable_thinking` + `thinking_budget`
- OpenAI o-series, DeepSeek-V4, GPT-5 → `reasoning_effort`
- All others → silently ignored.
